verdict.rationale: Tax calculation is a fair question for a billing and invoicing platform like Lago, so the axis applies. The pack documents invoice generation and invoice templates, but nothing on sales tax, VAT, or GST calculation, tax rates, registrations, or any tax integration. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As a finance lead, sales tax, VAT, and GST are calculated on every invoice — natively or through a first-class tax integration — with the right registrations and rates
